'_schema':'kosha_entry' cascades to every dictionary folder underneath, so
per-folder entries need no _schema of their own. The importer regenerates the
full folder list into data/kosha/_taxonomy_koshas.json each run -- paste that
generated list in place of the illustrative folders shown here.
